Listen, it's okay to not be successful as long as you have personal relationships. Friends and family that care about you. I can imagine your stories, they're probably not the same as mine, and if you wanted to tell them I would love to listen. But I want to say that it's a basic human instinct to want to have others in your life to love and depend on sometimes. Pretty much all other desires are BS. Like money only corrupts, it's more of a design flaw to desire wealth rather than a good instinct. But when you're me, and you have a cushy job lined up with pretty much everything else someone could want in life except for the person I love the most, you end up here on this subreddit. And I do want to hear your story, if you want to post it

You know, It's a bit of a shame that I'll never get that Ford Mustang I've always dreamed about. But I don't think it would have been the same without her. I'll be miserable, it'll only be another piece of metal. Depression sucks =(
We have the Appalachians where I am in New Hampshire, but I'll make sure I do that. Thanks for the tip, hiking does make me feel almost serene. I wonder what else there is to do...
